## Description {#details}

<p>This file provides the interface for the instcombine pass implementation.</p>


<p>The interface is used for generic transformations in this folder and target specific combinations in the targets. The visitor implementation is in <span class="doxyComputerOutput">InstCombinerImpl</span> in <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/transforms/lib/transforms/instcombine/instcombineinternal-h">InstCombineInternal.h</a></span>.</p>
